The command-line options of `StrataRuntime` at engine `319075e3f92b` (`c_Arguments`, `StrataRuntime/src/RuntimeApplication.cpp`).

| Option | Value | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--game` | `<file.stgame>` | Play this game (default: the one .stgame manifest next to the executable) |
| `--headless` |   | Run the game without a window or graphics, like a dedicated server (60 frames per second) |
| `--windowed` |   | Open a window even when the game asks for fullscreen |
| `--resolution` | `<width>x<height>` | Open a window of exactly this many pixels |
| `--frames` | `<count>` | Stop after this many frames (every fixed step runs: checks, screenshots) |
| `--seconds` | `<count>` | Stop once the game played this many seconds of game time, in fixed steps from its start (every fixed step runs: checks, screenshots) |
| `--screenshot` | `<file.png>` | Save the last frame (with --frames or --seconds, and a window) |
| `--asset-budget-mb` | `<megabytes>` | The GPU texture budget of the game's assets |
| `--perf-log` | `<file.csv>` | Write a row of frame timings per frame |
| `--save-directory` | `<folder>` | Keep the game's save files in this folder (default: the player's data) |
| `--quality` | `<low\|medium\|high\|ultra>` | Draw with this Graphics Quality preset for this run (default: the project's, with the players' saved options over it); nothing is saved |
| `--help` |   | Print this help and exit |
